_note: Module-level effects that existed on 2026-10-09 and were judged harmless (WORKFLOW 18). Outward effects (send, wallet spend, delete, db write, deploy) were fixed, not listed. A new entry needs a reason. LIMIT: classification goes by the name of the call. Calls classified as 'other' are listed by scripts/module_effects.py but are NOT checked against this baseline and do NOT block a merge; an effect behind a harmless-sounding name passes. 'other' is not a reviewed category. SECOND LIMIT: only direct calls in the module body are seen. A module-level call of a local function (e.g. X = helper(), where helper() runs git or sends) is 'other' and passes; reported 2026-10-10 for scripts/crontab_inventar.py, fixed there by hand. Cron programs outside the repository are scanned in the 08:00 report only; no CI sees them.
